commit_scope: Resolve remaining pulse latency at native route/access-path ownership and retire incorrect host event-loop ownership.
evidence_refs: During pulse latency diagnosis, Traefik repeatedly reported Router coherence-web cannot be linked automatically with multiple Services: coherence-web and coherence-web-hati. Both declared the same container port 3000; the www router had no explicit owner. A superseded two-host Hati router duplicated the current five-host route.

Extended existing BML Compose care with reusable model field replacement, array/map label normalization, and service-alias rehoming. All current Hati hosts and the root/www routes remain; duplicate port ownership and the older two-host router retire. Native publication preserves a private backup and uses same-directory rename.

First care attempt found Compose preserves labels as KEY=value arrays under --no-interpolate (str_find received a non-string). Added the native presentation lens. An incorrect node_tag spelling was corrected to the existing node_category/node_eq door; no kernel or lowering fallback was introduced. Failures retained by form-run and host-child; neither published a partial document.

Resumed native action successfully. The live model now has one coherence-web service port, all three current routers explicitly select it, and the five-host Hati rule is unchanged. No kernel or application suite ran.

Deploy guidance releases the obsolete manual sed deployment path and redundant recurring reads. It carries the observed provider-lock lesson beside the native latency trace and current source ownership.

After the lock repair, pulse exposed a separate transaction over 100 seconds: SELECT runtime_events WHERE source=$1 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT $2. The live table lacked a source/time index. Native runtime_read_care.bml declares reusable ordered-read blueprints, builds the missing index concurrently, and returns PostgreSQL validity and the actual worker-query plan. Index valid=true and ready=true; EXPLAIN now uses runtime_events_source_recorded_at rather than the parallel full scan. No row deletion, shorter history or query-limit reduction.

Native schema care's first compilation named an unavailable str-replace-all helper; identifier quoting was composed from existing split/join string resources instead. No kernel or fallback change. Online index care completed successfully; no active long transaction remained in the following source observation.

A focused 20-second live profile found synchronous idea loading/copying, repeated route-registry reads, vitality SQL and a blocking native-kernel call on MainThread. Released five incorrect async declarations at the retiring HTTP membrane (ready, contention, idea list/detail, vitality). Existing synchronous framework dispatch owns these bodies; no new Python business logic, background workaround, pool, threshold or timeout was added.

Native Compose care activated web without rebuilding or touching dependencies. The running www and five-host Hati routers both name coherence-web; the duplicate port owner is absent; public www returned 200. The earlier lock repair deployment completed successfully in run 39184717055.

local_validation.summary: Native route/index care, selected live model/query plan and source profile; no suite.
